name: LM358
description: Dual bipolar op-amp designed for single-supply operation; inputs work down to the negative rail (ground). Cheap and ubiquitous for sensors, comparators, and non-audio signal conditioning. Noisy for audio.

pins.name: V-
pins.description: negative supply / ground in single-supply use

extra.Vos: 3mV typ (7mV max) @ Ta=25C, LM358 grade (9mV max full range)
extra.Ibias: -20nA typ (-250nA max) @ Ta=25C, LM358 grade (-500nA max full range)
extra.Iout: 20mA min source, 10mA min sink @ Vs=15V (short-circuit current +-40mA typ, +-60mA max)

typical_application: Single-supply sensor amplification, comparators, level detection. Inputs can sit at 0V which is why it suits ground-referenced sensors.
gotchas: output cannot swing to the positive rail; tops out about 1.5V below Vcc
crossover distortion near 0V output makes it poor for audio
slow slew rate (0.3 V/us) limits it to low-frequency signals
